                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The word "inquisitive" means having a strong desire to learn or know more, often characterized by curiosity or eagerness to ask questions. (जिज्ञासु)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: The child was extremely inquisitive, constantly asking how things worked.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The word "Antique" refers to something that is old and valuable, especially an object that belongs to a past era and holds historical or artistic significance. (प्राचीन वस्तु)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: The museum had a beautiful collection of antique furniture from the 18th century.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Both "Antique" and "Ancient" denote an association with the past, but "Ancient" specifically means very old in general, making it the most appropriate synonym for "Antique".

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Young (युवा): Refers to something or someone in the early stages of growth or development.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t

(आक्रामक)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The sentence highlights an orthodox view where people are resistant to the idea of women getting educated and employed, reflecting hostility.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The other options: "friendly," "meticulous," and "elaborate" do not convey the required meaning of hostility.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ​Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 1'.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t

(छुपा हुआ वरदान)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: Losing his flight turned out to be a blessing in disguise as he avoided a major accident.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • In the given sentence, losing the job, though initially perceived as bad, led to starting a successful business, which is a positive outcome. Therefore, "a blessing in disguise" is the most appropriate substitution.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: Winning the scholarship was a golden opportunity for her to study abroad.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Option 2: A diamond in the rough (अनगढ़ हीरा): A person or thing with exceptional potential but needing refinement.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: The young recruit is a diamond in the rough; he just needs proper training to shine.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Option 4: A mixed blessing (मिश्रित वरदान): Something that has both good and bad aspects.\n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The preceding sentence establishes the computer as a "threat to man".
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • We need a word that indicates a negative impact or risk caused by a threat.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Complete Passage with Fillers: The computer can become a threat to man.
